alert.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 5 at 1:30AM CDT until October 6 at 1:00PM CDT by NWS Green Bay WI

alerts.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 5 at 1:30AM CDT until October 6 at 1:00PM CDT by NWS Green Bay WI
alerts.description:
* WHAT...For the first Small Craft Advisory, south winds 15 to 25
kts with gusts up to 30 kts and waves 3 to 6 ft expected. For
the Gale Watch, south winds 20 to 25 kts with gusts up to 34
kts and waves 5 to 8 ft possible. For the second Small Craft
Advisory, southwest winds 10 to 15 kts with gusts up to 25 kts
and waves 4 to 7 ft expected.

* WHERE...Lake Michigan nearshore waters from Sturgeon Bay to
Sheboygan.

* WHEN...For the first Small Craft Advisory, from 7 AM to 1 PM
CDT Tuesday. For the Gale Watch, from Tuesday afternoon
through Tuesday evening. For the second Small Craft Advisory,
from 7 PM Tuesday to 1 AM CDT Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds can cause hazardous waves which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
